strings.name: Cate Blanchett
strings.summary: Blanchett began in Australian drama training and theatre, gained international attention in Elizabeth and won Oscars for The Aviator and Blue Jasmine. Her work spans commercial films, auteur cinema and theatre, including joint leadership of Sydney Theatre Company with Andrew Upton. Alongside acting and production, she has served as a UNHCR goodwill ambassador since 2016, advocating refugee protection.
